sourceReferences: design-review-locked/Mentora Showcase.dc.html § 22 Product Preview — Instructor dashboard mobile mockup (reused as the closest available reference)

conflicts.description: The showcase's reference mockup shows 4 stat cards (including 'Avg. completion rate') and a DataTable with Publish-toggle/Students/Updated-date columns. The locked ux/INSTRUCTOR_ADMIN_UX.md § 1 specifies exactly 3 stat cards (total courses, published count, total enrollments) and a Title/Status-Badge/Enrollment-count/Completion-rate column set.
conflicts.resolution: The locked UX spec (rank 1) wins. The current implementation correctly ships 3 stat cards and the locked column set — the showcase's 4th card and different columns are NOT implemented, by design, not by omission.

layout.structure: stat card row -> "Create Course" primary action -> DataTable of owned courses

content: 3 statCards: total courses, published count, total enrollments — LOCKED count, never 4
DataTable: title, status Badge, enrollment count, completion rate, row action — header row uppercase (D49 correction)

artworkRules: n/a — DataTable rows, no course-thumbnail artwork on this screen.

exitDestinations: Course Editor — Overview (new or existing course)

states.loading: skeleton stat cards + skeleton table rows
states.empty: "you haven't created a course yet" + CTA "Create Course"

rtlBehavior: table headers/columns and row content mirror per logical properties; status badge stays leading the row's title per logical start
responsiveRules: shared/responsive.json#/perSurfaceRules/dataTable — collapses to stacked cards below tablet; stat cards stack 1-2 per row on narrow viewports
knownGaps: 4th stat card and showcase's alternate table columns are an intentional, disclosed, unresolved gap — not a defect (see conflicts above).
